messages.subject: Localization of Shiny apps
parts:
Hi,

I would like to localize my shiny apps. Currently I have two folders "xxx_en" and "xxx_de" and from the folder name ending the app knows if it should display in german (de) or english (en). The source code in ui.R and server.R is identical, because I utilize only different language files. However, I have seen that I could use an additional paramete in the URL, e.g. "xxx/app?lang=de". In server.R I can access the parameter by "parseQueryString(session$clientData$url_search)". Is it possible to access the long parameter in ui.R, too?

Thanks in advance  Sigbert
